summary: First Keystone Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 notifying holders that it will redeem all outstanding 4.375% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due December 31, 2030, with an aggregate principal of $25,000,000. Redemption is scheduled for September 30, 2026 at 100% of principal plus accrued interest to the redemption date. This is a full redemption of debt, not equity, so it falls outside typical special-situation categories. Watch for the redemption's impact on the company's balance sheet and any refinancing plans, but no risk-arb angle exists.
